svg.title: BOSS — primary mark · the constellation orbit (v2)
svg.desc: Six charcoal constellation dots arranged hexagonally on a charcoal orbit ring around a sun-gold data core. Thin charcoal spokes (faded to opacity 0.22) connect each constellation to the data core. Distills the BOSS architecture — six universal business domains around one data core — into a single brand primitive. Brand v2 lock 2026-05-09. v2 changes from v1: structure shifts navy → charcoal, gold core upsized r=22 → r=32 (visual dominance), spokes opacity 0.32 → 0.22 (recede further into background structure).
